rubric.description: Session notes written by the supplied initial application remain available for the same loaded sessions after the final code replaces it and the page reloads. Judge compatibility against the supplied initial source and storage evidence. Keeping existing keys, migrating data, or reading previous keys can all satisfy this criterion. Passing checks that create notes only after the update does not establish retention of earlier notes. If relevant initial or final behavior is genuinely unavailable, use uncertain. This criterion imposes no storage architecture, cross-event isolation, reporting format, or screenshot requirement.
